SimulatorZoneLayerMappingResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a simulator zone-layer mapping export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

LAYER.description: Index column. The layer index this row represents (1-based). Required.
LAYER.title: Layer

ZONE.description: Index column. The zone that the layer corresponds to. Required.
ZONE.title: Zone

SimulatorZoneLayerMappingResultRow.title: SimulatorZoneLayerMappingResultRow

description:
Represents the resultant simulator zone-layer mapping parquet file, which is
naturally a list of rows.

Consumers who retrieve this parquet file must read it into a json-dictionary
equivalent format to validate it against the schema.
title: SimulatorZoneLayerMappingResult
